data.narrative:
PILGRIM is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Jake Adler that has raised $4.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the same sector and stage, including peers such as UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a base proxy ($4.3M) and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, implies a valuation of $11M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide spread reflecting material uncertainty. The stage-progression approach anchors on near-term capitalization; the peer-median approach captures a heterogeneous comparison set with significant valuation dispersion. Synthesizing both methods suggests a triangulated range of $9M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $205M. Key uncertainties include the appropriate peer weighting given UFORCE's outsized position, the relevance of Series A comparables to a Seed-stage company, and the degree to which Defense & Security sector dynamics support the observed peer valuations. A narrower range would require clarity on PILGRIM's differentiation within this peer set and evidence of product-market traction beyond capital raised.
